description: This file defines a template class 'LuaLib' for integrating C++ types with Lua scripting, including registration, pushing, checking, and metamethods for Lua userdata. It also contains macros for defining Lua bindings and a namespace structure for Lua-related utilities.

classes.name: LuaLib
classes.description: A template class providing Lua binding functionalities for C++ types, including registration, userdata management, and metamethods.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a C++ type T with Lua, creating metatables and binding functions.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a C++ object of type T onto the Lua stack as userdata.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks and retrieves a C++ object of type T from the Lua stack at a given position.

methods.name: thunk
methods.description: Calls a C closure with upvalues, used internally for Lua-C++ function calls.

methods.name: tostring
methods.description: Provides a string representation of a C++ object pointer for Lua.

methods.name: gc_T
methods.description: Metamethod for garbage collection; deletes object if owned.

methods.name: tostring_T
methods.description: Metamethod for converting userdata to string.

methods.name: _regfunctions
methods.description: Registers methods, getters, and setters for a Lua type.
